title: Ten Moves at the Wedding
summary: On the wedding day, Yun Shan promises Gu He the sect's future, while privately telling Protector Wu of the Hall of Souls he may take Gu He's soul afterwards. Protector Wu reminds Yun Shan that the Hall of Souls saved his life and gave him Dou Zong strength. As Yun Yun and Gu He bow, Xiao Yan stops the ceremony, backed by Jia Xing Tian and the capital's powers. To keep Gu He out of the fight, Xiao Yan challenges him to ten moves. Gu He uses the Purple Flame and his Thousand Flame Sword Blades, and Yun Shan thinks Xiao Yan is bluffing. On the tenth move Gu He loses, calls off the wedding and leaves. Yun Shan says Xiao Yan's father is with the Hall of Souls and orders his disciples to kill the intruders.
